notes.title: Abandoned Crypt
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750437/97b0b8551230b7db70556f55ff6704679cf1395e.jpg[/img]


Somewhere within the forest and hidden in a dark and long abandoned crypt, worshipers of Zuriel prayed to statues in honour of the demon lord.

Performing rituals and supplicating to this demon the worshipers risked their very souls, but to escape the Hollow you will need to uncover the true purpose of the crypt and the strange symbols it contains.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750437/1252dabb0ed39f93d4fabbdf045cd9fb982ae9dc.png[/img]

notes.title: Mysterious Elevator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750437/3c0ce5805f80706c8dedcf60fe0aa18cf14dfa17.jpg[/img]

The mysterious elevator lays hidden somewhere within the Barrett estate manor house.

Search the manor to discover its location and uncover the secret of the lift’s ultimate destination.


[h2]Announcing Ray Tracing Support[/h2]

The House in The Hollow will feature full support for global illumination, ray traced reflections, ray traced shadows, ray traced ambient occlusion including ray traced translucency.

The game can be enjoyed on graphics cards without raytracing support, but to enhance the games visuals a ray tracing capable graphics card will enable the most realistic and beautiful game world and environment possible for the player to explore.

notes.title: Meet Aloysius Abadier
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750437/97c2c0a7a4a4ce89c34e245774631eadcc09aca4.jpg[/img]

Famed Occultist Francis Barrett disappeared over a century ago.

The secretive Temple he founded in London, where he and his followers practiced their dark craft, lay abandoned and in ruin.

Meet Aloysius Abadier.

During the demolition of the Temple Aloysius discovered a small notebook and map hinting at the location of the lost Barrett Estate.

Take on the role of Aloysius as he searches for the lost Estate and Manor, to unravel the mystery surrounding Francis Barrett’s sudden disappearance.

notes.title: Magus Manuscript
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35750437/adc2e5afbc71239aa73bd1332564696d3af12276.jpg[/img]

In 1890 Francis Barrett created and authored the "MAGUS", a compendium of occult magic.

Shortly after the book’s publication he vanished from public life.

Somewhere in Breabrook forest is the lost Barrett Estate & Manor House where the original manuscript lies hidden.

Find the manuscript and discover if it may have played a part in the mysterious circumstances surrounding his disappearance.
